logline: Learning from his mother that Rupert and Catherine framed Juliana for witchcraft and sentenced her to death right after their upcoming wedding, Alexander vows to return from the dead and reclaim everything stolen from him.
continuity_notes: Picking up immediately from the revelation in Episode 35 that the men ruling Ashwood orchestrated Alexander's ambush, Alexander learns of Juliana's imprisonment and looming execution.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium two-shot across the weathered wooden table lit by the warm glow of an oil lantern, framing Alexander and his mother leaning inward in the dimly lit cabin.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander's mother leans forward with both hands on the rustic table, searching her son's scarred face in disbelief.

events.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Whispering, Distraught)
events.content: "Then why did they never find you?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Alexander, his dark combat scar prominent as his eyes burn with steady, cold intensity.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Bitter)
events.content: "Because they made certain no one would look."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up on Alexander's mother, her hood framing her pale, weathered face as shock deepens across her features.

events.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Trembling)
events.content: "Who?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Side profile shot of Alexander gazing toward the open doorway before slowly turning back to face his mother directly.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Grave, Sinister)
events.content: "Sterling... and Rupert."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up on Alexander's mother as her breath hitches and her eyes widen in pure horror.

events.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Gasping, Stricken)
events.content: "Rupert?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot of the wooden cabin interior. Alexander stands upright opposite his mother across the lantern-lit map.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Stern, Resolute)
events.content: "They knew where I was."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Alexander leaning over the table, his eyes locked onto his mother as suppressed rage surfaces.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Fierce)
events.content: "My position was leaked to the French... before I could expose what I had discovered."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Alexander's mother clutching the collar of her dark cloak, her chest heaving with agony.

events.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Horrified)
events.content: "They gave you to the enemy?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Alexander straightening his posture, his jaw set hard.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Deadpan, Resolute)
events.content: "They gave them my location."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up on Alexander's eyes and scarred cheek, teeth bared in contempt.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Spitting with Contempt)
events.content: "They wanted the investigation buried."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Alexander's mother leaning over the map, her voice cracking.

events.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Shattered)
events.content: "And when you disappeared...?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Alexander, his voice low and cutting.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Cold)
events.content: "They declared me dead."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot from the side of the wooden table as his mother brings both hands up to cover her mouth in overwhelmed grief.

events.label: ALEXANDER (O.S.) (Grave)
events.content: "They falsified what remained of the reports."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander's mother presses her trembling hands against her lips, tears brimming in her eyes.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up on his mother weeping openly, her ring catching the warm lamplight as she lowers her hand to her heart.

events.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Tearful, Bitter)
events.content: "And Rupert took Ashbourne."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up on Alexander's piercing blue-grey eyes, unwavering and hardened by years of exile.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Darkly)
events.content: "While the world mourned a dead heir."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on his mother's sorrowful gaze lifting toward him.

events.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Choked with Tears)
events.content: "And I mourned you."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Alexander looking down, his harsh features softening momentarily with sorrow.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Softly)
events.content: "I know."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up on his mother bowing her head toward the rustic tabletop, weeping in utter despair.

events.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Sobbing)
events.content: "I trusted them."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot as Alexander stands tall beside the weeping mother seated at the table.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Gentle yet Firm)
events.content: "You trusted family."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Profile close-up of Alexander stepping closer to the door, staring out into the falling snow.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Resentful)
events.content: "They used that trust against you."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Alexander steps back toward the table, leaning in urgently toward his mother.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Urgent, Anxious)
events.content: "Mother... Juliana..."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up on Alexander leaning both hands on the table, desperate for answers.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Intense)
events.content: "She went into Ashbourne Manor to save you. She never came back."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up on Alexander's strained, furrowed brow.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Tremulous)
events.content: "I thought perhaps she stayed with you."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of his mother looking up at him, agony and hesitation washing over her face.

events.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Hesitant, Trembling)
events.content: "Alexander..."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Quick push-in close-up on Alexander, his eyes snapping open in sudden panic.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Alarmed)
events.content: "What?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on his mother, tears shining in the amber lamplight.

events.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Choked)
events.content: "She did come to me."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium two-shot as Alexander bends over the table, crowding his mother with fierce desperation.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Demanding)
events.content: "Is she still at Ashbourne?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Alexander's mother shutting her eyes and weeping, shaking her head in deep anguish.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot as Alexander towers over her, his breathing turning ragged.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Desperate)
events.content: "Then where is she?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up on Alexander's mother crying out in wretched guilt and horror.

events.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Wailing)
events.content: "They arrested her!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Alexander, his expression freezing in complete shock.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Stunned)
events.content: "Arrested?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up as his mother clutches Alexander's forearms with desperate, pleading hands.

events.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Despairing)
events.content: "Rupert and Catherine accused her of poisoning me!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Alexander, absolute fury erupting across his scarred face.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Shouting, Incredulous)
events.content: "But she saved you!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on his mother, clutching her chest in grief.

events.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Weeping)
events.content: "I told them!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Alexander clenching his fists at his sides, trembling with rage.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Furious)
events.content: "You told them the truth!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on his mother as she cries out, devastated by the memory of the kangaroo court.

events.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Agonized)
events.content: "They called her a witch!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Frontal medium shot of Alexander standing frozen, the weight of the realization crashing down on him.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Horrified)
events.content: "Juliana... is in a cell?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of his mother clutching her temple, reeling in remembered trauma.

events.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Weak, Trembling)
events.content: "She was taken before a magistrate."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight shot of Alexander, his eyes wild with terror for his wife.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Barking)
events.content: "And?!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on his mother breaking down into inconsolable sobs.

events.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Weeping)
events.content: "They condemned her."

events.label: ALEXANDER (O.S.) (Gasping)
events.content: "No."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on his mother looking up through her tears, delivering the horrifying reality.

events.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Solemn, Shattered)
events.content: "She is to be executed."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot of the cabin as Alexander stands stiff as iron, stunned by the looming death sentence.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Guttural, Demanding)
events.content: "When?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on his mother, her hand clutched tightly against her throat.

events.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Trembling)
events.content: "After the wedding."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Alexander, narrowing his eyes in lethal suspicion.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Menacing)
events.content: "What wedding?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Profile close-up of his mother looking at him across the lantern light.

events.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Grim)
events.content: "Rupert... and Catherine's."

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: A sudden dramatic metallic swell underscores the impending deadline.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Frontal close-up on his mother, solemn and resolute in her warning.

events.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Deadly Serious)
events.content: "Two days from now."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Profile shot of Alexander as dark realization settles over his face, turning to a grim, predatory glare.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Simmering with Fury)
events.content: "They are marrying in two days..."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight, terrifying close-up on Alexander's eyes flashing with murderous wrath.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Deadly, Throaty)
events.content: "...and killing my wife afterward."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot as his mother urgently grabs Alexander's coat, pleading with him.

events.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Pleading, Terrified)
events.content: "Alexander, you cannot go back there alone!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Alexander, towering over her, immovable and consumed by purpose.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Grave, Seething)
events.content: "They already took my name."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Alexander stepping forward, his voice rising with lethal thunder.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Roaring with Conviction)
events.content: "They stole my home!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up on his furious, bared teeth and wild eyes.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Venomous)
events.content: "And now they have taken Juliana!"

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Close-up of Alexander's gloved hand clenching into a tight, leather-creaking fist.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: The sharp, taut creak of leather straining under monstrous grip strength.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tracking shot following Alexander as he turns his back on the warmth of the cabin and walks boldly toward the open double barn doors.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander stands framed in the doorway, staring out into the vast, snow-covered pine forest under the cold moonlight.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Calm, Chilling)
events.content: "Two days."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot from inside the cabin, showing his mother clutching her chest, looking after Alexander's imposing silhouette standing at the threshold of the blizzard.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Vow of Vengeance)
events.content: "Then they have two days to celebrate."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Side profile close-up on Alexander as his breath fogs into the icy winter night air, his jaw clenched tight.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Low, Menacing Promise)
events.content: "Because before that wedding begins..."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight side profile close-up of Alexander's battle-scarred cheek and burning gaze as he makes his final declaration.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Thunderous Finale)
events.content: "...their dead Duke is coming home."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Alexander stares resolutely ahead into the dark, snowy woods as the camera holds on his grim, determined expression before cutting to black.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: A heavy, ominous orchestral swell builds to a thunderous cliffhanger sting and reverberates into silence.

analysis_metadata.note: No invented LLM scene metadata; event-level evidence drives promo selection.
